meta.description: A spiritual and practical Umrah guide, offline and in four languages: steps, sourced supplications, Tawaf and Sa'i counters, places in Makkah and Madinah.

umrah.title: My Umrah
umrah.intro: The Umrah journey, step by step. Every instruction shows its sources.
umrah.noDuas: No specific supplication is established for this step: supplicate freely.

counter.disclaimer: This counter is a practical aid, not a religious validation. If in doubt, count the lower number.

explore.notARite: This visit is not part of the Umrah rites.

checklist.title: Pre-departure checklist
checklist.intro: Tick items as you go. Your ticks are saved on this device.
checklist.resetConfirm: Untick every item in the checklist?

offline.title: Offline content
offline.intro: Download the languages you will need before you leave. YouTube videos and the map require Internet.

offline.installHint: On iPhone: Share button, then "Add to Home Screen". On Android: ⋮ menu, then "Install app".

focus.title: Performing Umrah
focus.finished: Your Umrah is complete. May Allah accept it.

sources.title: References and sources
sources.intro: Every reference used in the app. Hadith numbers follow sunnah.com numbering.

about.title: About and disclaimer
about.p1: Omra Companion is a support tool. It does not replace the advice of a qualified scholar, nor the instructions of the Saudi authorities and staff on site.
about.p2: The Arabic texts of the supplications are reproduced from the cited sources. Translations are translations of meaning written for this app: they are not official and must be reviewed by a qualified person.
about.p3: Schools of jurisprudence differ on some points; these differences are noted without being settled. If in doubt, ask a trusted scholar.
about.p4: Practical information (access, bookings, permits) changes: check it on the official Nusuk and Ministry of Hajj and Umrah platforms.
